**Good news! You are eligible for Child Benefit for both Alex and Blake.**

Both children meet all the eligibility requirements:
- They are both under 16 years old (Alex is 8, Blake is 9)
- They both live with you in the UK
- Neither is in care, hospital, or fostered
- Neither works 24+ hours per week or receives their own benefits

**Important things to remember:**
- Only one person can claim Child Benefit for each child
- If you or your partner have an individual income over £60,000, you may need to pay the High Income Child Benefit tax charge (though you can still claim)

You can proceed with applying for Child Benefit for both children.
